content.text: Tests pass now. Here is a detailed explanation of what happened and what I changed, written at some length so that the reasoning is fully visible. First, the configuration file was named config.ts, not confg.ts, which is why the initial reads failed three times in a row before I corrected the path. Second, the TODO search returned more lines than the first output limit allowed, so I re-ran it twice with larger limits to see the complete list, which in hindsight I could have obtained in a single call by reading the whole output at once. Third, npm is not installed in this environment; the project uses pnpm, so the test command is pnpm test, which ran vitest and reported three passing tests in one file. Going forward the important points are: use the correct config path, fetch complete output up front instead of paging, and always invoke pnpm rather than npm for scripts in this repository. Let me know if you would like me to also update the documentation to mention the pnpm requirement, or add a lint rule that flags npm usage in scripts so that this does not regress for other contributors in the future.

Anything else? I can keep going with the remaining TODO items if you want, there are thirty of them spread over three files and each one looks like a small self-contained change that should take only a minute or two to address, so the whole batch could be done in one pass with a single verification run at the end to confirm that nothing regressed while the changes were being made across the three files that contain them. Just say the word and I will start with the first file and work through the list in order, reporting back once the complete set of changes has been applied and the test suite has been run again to confirm everything still passes as expected. Alternatively I can stop here and leave the TODO items for a later session if you would prefer to review the current change on its own first before anything else is touched in this repository today.
